questions.question: Why did King Belshazzar order the gold vessels from God's temple in Jerusalem brought into his feast?

answers.text: So they could drink from them
So they could be sent back
So they could be melted down

questions.question: When a hand appeared and wrote on the wall at King Belshazzar's feast, what happened to the king?

answers.text: His face grew pale and his knees knocked together
He laughed and lifted his cup toward the hand
He jumped up and shouted for his palace guards

questions.question: Daniel explained the writing on King Belshazzar's wall. What did he say the word MENE means?

answers.text: God has numbered the days of the king's reign
God has forgiven the pride of the king
God will add more years to the king's reign

questions.question: The same night Daniel explained the writing on the wall, King Belshazzar was killed. Who received his kingdom?
